metadata.name: sealed_auction
metadata.description: Sealed-bid uniform-price auctions for SPL tokens, with bids kept private by Arcium MPC

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Second step: the proposed admin accepts.

instructions.name: add_book_page
docs: Adds a page to the auction's bid book ahead of time, room for
`PAGE_BIDS` more bids, up to `MAX_PREPAID_PAGES` pages (and the
auction's `max_pages`). Only the seller, while bidding is still open;
`page` is the next page's number (1 to 3). Further pages open on
demand (`open_book_page`).
The seller pays the page's rent, which comes back when the auction is
closed, and adds to the crank pool what finding the clearing price
across the pages may cost (`page_crank_fee`); what is not used comes
back then too. Once more than one page holds bids, the clearing price
is found a page at a time (`fold_clearing`) instead of in one step.

accounts.name: fold
docs: Made with the second page.

accounts.name: book
docs: The book's first page, read when its index starts.

accounts.name: book_index
docs: Made with the second page.

instructions.name: add_items
docs: Appends items to an item list that is not sealed yet. Each item needs
a name (display text of at most `MAX_ITEM_NAME_LEN` bytes) and at
least one NFT; a list holds at most `MAX_ITEMS` items and
`MAX_COLLECTION_SIZE` NFTs. Items keep their order: the first item's
NFTs are numbers 0 onwards, the next item's follow, and so on.

accounts.name: computation_account
docs: against the bid's pending computation.

accounts.name: book
docs: The bid's page, named by `settle_bid`; checked in the handler.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: reward.

instructions.name: bootstrap_liquidity
docs: Opens the planned pool once every bid is settled, locks its position
for good and pays the seller the rest of the proceeds, less the sale
fee. Anyone can call it. If DAMM v2's pool for this token and SOL
already exists, no pool opens and the seller gets everything.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone can open the pool once the sale is settled.

instructions.name: cancel_auction
docs: Lets the seller withdraw a token auction that nobody has bid on yet.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: fee.

instructions.name: cancel_collection_auction
docs: Lets the seller withdraw a collection auction that nobody has bid on
yet. `close_collection_auction` then hands over the empty collection.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: fee.

instructions.name: check_batch
docs: Checks the next batch of bids and stores it, encrypted, in the bid
book. Anyone can call this once bidding has closed. Pass the bids with
indices `checked_count..checked_count + min(BATCH_SIZE, remaining)` as
remaining accounts, in order, and as `book` the page that holds them.

accounts.name: book
docs: The page of the book that receives the batch record in the callback;
checked in the handler.

accounts.name: computation_account
docs: against the auction's pending computation.

accounts.name: book
docs: The page named by `check_batch`; checked in the handler.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: reward.

instructions.name: claim_collection_proceeds
docs: Pays the seller of a collection auction its proceeds, less the
platform's sale fee, on the same conditions as `claim_proceeds`.
Unsold NFTs are simply never minted; winners can still claim theirs
afterwards. A hidden collection pays out only once revealed. If it
sold nothing it can finish without a reveal; if it sold NFTs and was
never revealed, it can finish (with nothing to pay) once the time to
reveal is over and every winner has taken their payment back.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: fee.

instructions.name: claim_nfts
docs: Mints NFTs that a winning bid of a collection auction is owed,
straight to the bid's owner. The bid holds places `first_position`
onwards, one per NFT it won; each place becomes an NFT number through
the shuffle `draw_nft_seed` drew (`shuffled_items`). Should the draw
never have happened by the time the safety net opens, each place is
its own number, so winners can always collect. Pass the asset
addresses of the bid's next places as remaining accounts, writable:
`[ASSET_SEED, auction, place]` for each place from `first_position +
nfts_claimed` on, at most `MAX_NFTS_PER_CLAIM` and no more than the
bid is still owed. Anyone can call it and pays the NFTs' rent; the
NFTs only ever go to the bid's owner. A collection named per item
needs its `item_list`, and a hidden one must have been revealed.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the NFTs' rent.

accounts.name: item_list
docs: Only for a collection named per item: its item list.

instructions.name: claim_pool_fees
docs: Claims the pool's trading fees and pays them out: 80% to the seller,
20% to the platform. Anyone can call it.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone can claim; the fees only ever go to the seller and the
platform.

instructions.name: claim_proceeds
docs: Pays the seller: SOL proceeds, less the platform's sale fee, plus any
unsold tokens. Allowed once every bid is resolved, once an auction
without bids has ended, or once the safety net is open (unsettled bids
then stay refundable by their owners). Tokens that winners have not
collected yet stay in the vault for them.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: fee.

instructions.name: claim_tokens
docs: Delivers a winning bid's tokens to its owner's associated token
account. Anyone can call it and pays for that account if it does not
exist yet; the tokens only ever go to the bid's owner. Once the seller
has been paid and the last winner has collected, the empty vault is
closed and its rent returned to the seller.

accounts.name: computation_account
docs: against the auction's pending computation.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: its reward.

instructions.name: close_auction
docs: Closes a finished or cancelled auction once every bid account is
closed, returning the rent of the auction, its bid book and its vault
to the seller. Nothing is owed to anyone at that point, so tokens still
in the vault (sent there by someone after the sale) go to the seller.
An auction with more than one page of bid book passes the further
pages it still has (`close_book_page` closes the others), in order, as
remaining accounts, and its `fold` and `book_index`; they close too.

accounts.name: fold
docs: Only for an auction with more than one page: its paged clearing.

accounts.name: book_index
docs: Only for an auction with more than one page: its book's index.

accounts.name: vault
docs: the handler.

accounts.name: list
docs: Only for a sale with an allowlist, once set: closes too.

instructions.name: close_bid
docs: Returns what is left of a settled bid's deposit, plus the account's
rent, to its owner once anything it won has been delivered. Anyone can
call it; the lamports only ever go to the bid's owner.

instructions.name: close_bid_note
docs: Closes a bid note and returns its rent to the bidder: at any time by
the bidder, and by anyone once the bid itself is closed.

accounts.name: bid
docs: in the handler.

instructions.name: close_book_page
docs: Closes the last page of a finished or cancelled auction's book, once
every bid account is closed, and returns its rent to the seller. A
book with many pages closes this way, a page at a time from the end,
down to its second page, which closes with the auction
(`close_auction`, `close_collection_auction`) together with the paged
clearing and the book's index. Anyone can call it; the rent only goes
to the seller.

accounts.name: page_book
docs: The book's last page; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: close_collection_auction
docs: Closes a finished or cancelled collection auction once every bid
account is closed, which means every NFT sold has been minted. Makes
the seller the collection's update authority and returns the rent of
the auction, its bid book and its item list to the seller. Further
pages of the book, the `fold` and the `book_index` close too, as in
`close_auction`.

accounts.name: fold
docs: Only for an auction with more than one page: its paged clearing.

accounts.name: book_index
docs: Only for an auction with more than one page: its book's index.

accounts.name: item_list
docs: Only for a collection named per item: its item list, closed here.

instructions.name: close_item_list
docs: Closes an item list that no auction uses, returning its rent to the
seller. A list sealed into an auction closes with it
(`close_collection_auction`).

instructions.name: close_participant
docs: Returns a `Participant`'s rent to its wallet once bidding is over (or
the auction is gone). Anyone can call it.

accounts.name: auction
docs: already be closed.

instructions.name: create_auction
docs: Opens a token auction: escrows `terms.supply` base units, creates the
auction's bid book (its rent comes back with `close_auction`) and
charges the listing fee.
Prices are lamports per `terms.price_unit` base units, a power of ten
up to `MAX_PRICE_UNIT`; bids below `terms.min_price` do not count, and
every bid deposits at least `terms.min_deposit` and names a private
budget of at least that much, which its deposit covers. `fees` are
the most the seller accepts to pay; opening fails if the platform's
are higher.
`rules` are the sale's optional rules (see `SaleRules`): a minimum
raise, an allowlist (whose list `set_allowlist` then records) and,
with an allowlist, a cap on each wallet's deposits.

accounts.name: vault
docs: `init_if_needed` because anyone can create an associated token account
for any owner; a pre-created vault is still owned by this auction.

instructions.name: create_collection_auction
docs: Opens an auction for a new NFT collection of `terms.supply` items. The
Metaplex Core collection is created here, with the auction as its
update authority so that only this program can add NFTs to it. Each
NFT is minted straight to its winner by `claim_nfts`; unsold NFTs are
never minted. `close_collection_auction` hands the collection to the
seller.
Prices are ticks of `NFT_PRICE_SCALE` lamports per NFT. A bid asks for
1 to `terms.max_per_bid` NFTs and deposits at least that many times its
price.
NFT `i` (from 0) is named `"{item_name} #{i + 1}"`; its metadata is
`item_uri` followed by `"{i}.json"` when `uri_per_item` is set, or
`item_uri` itself otherwise. Which NFT numbers each winner gets is
drawn after the sale (`draw_nft_seed`). A non-zero `royalty_bps` adds
a Royalties plugin that pays the seller on secondary sales.
With `item_list` (made with `init_item_list` and `add_items` for this
auction's address), NFTs are named per item instead (`item_nft_name`);
the list must add up to the supply, and is sealed here. With
`collection.hidden`, `item_uri` is a commitment: its files need not
exist yet, and NFTs can be claimed only once the seller reveals them
(`reveal_collection`). Both need `uri_per_item`.

accounts.name: item_list
docs: Only for a collection named per item: its item list, sealed here.

instructions.name: draw_nft_seed
docs: Has Arcium draw the seed that decides which NFTs each winner of a
collection gets. It can only be drawn once every bid is settled: by
then each winning bid holds its places (`Bid::first_position`), and
nobody knew the seed while they were handed out, so nobody can steer
which NFTs a win becomes. Anyone can call it.

accounts.name: computation_account
docs: against the auction's pending computation.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: reward.

instructions.name: emergency_refund
docs: Safety net: once `EMERGENCY_DELAY_SECS` have passed since the end of
bidding, an unsettled bid's full deposit and the account's rent go back
to its owner and the bid counts as lost. That includes a collection bid
at the clearing price whose share can no longer be finalized because
another such bid was never revealed. Anyone can call it; the lamports
only ever go to the bid's owner.

instructions.name: finalize_share
docs: Settles a collection bid at the clearing price once every such bid is
revealed: they share what the bids above them left, in proportion to
their size and rounded down, and the NFTs lost to rounding go one each
to the earliest of them (lowest bid index), so every NFT is sold.
Anyone can call it; the payment moves to the auction as in any
settlement. `book` is the page that holds the bid. A book with more
than one page also passes its `book_index`, once `tally_clearing_page`
has counted every page.

accounts.name: book
docs: The page of the book that holds the bid; checked in the handler.

accounts.name: book_index
docs: Only for a book with more than one page: its index.

instructions.name: find_clearing
docs: Reveals the clearing price once every bid is checked, from all the
batch records at once. Anyone can call it. Only while the bids fit on
the first page of the book; with more, `fold_clearing` finds the
price a page at a time.

accounts.name: book
docs: The first page, which then holds every batch record; the cluster
reads them in place.

accounts.name: computation_account
docs: against the auction's pending computation.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: reward.

instructions.name: fold_clearing
docs: Runs the next step of the paged clearing, for an auction whose bids
fill more than one page of its book: `fold_batch` reads one page for
one digit of the clearing price (see `FOLD_PASSES`), and the step that
ends the last pass reveals the price as `find_clearing` does. Anyone
can call it once every bid is checked; pass as `book` the page the
auction's `ClearingFold` names. Each step that succeeds pays its
caller `fold_reward` from the crank pool.

accounts.name: fold
docs: Holds the state the cluster reads in place.

accounts.name: book
docs: The page this step reads (`ClearingFold::page`), whose batch records
the cluster reads in place; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: increase_bid
docs: Replaces a sealed bid while bidding is open: a new encryption of
`BidInput { price, quantity }` under a fresh key (with the same
address-bound nonce as `place_bid`), and `extra_deposit` more lamports
on its deposit. A deposit can only grow, so a bid can never be shrunk
or pulled to fake demand; the app only offers raising the price and
size. Only the latest version is checked when bidding closes, against
the whole deposit. `book` is the page of the bid book that holds the
bid (`page_slot`); a book with more than one page also passes its
`book_index`, and a sale with an allowlist the bidder's `participant`,
which the wallet cap applies to.

accounts.name: book
docs: The page of the book that holds the bid; checked in the handler.

accounts.name: book_index
docs: Only for a book with more than one page: its index.

accounts.name: participant
docs: Only in a sale with an allowlist: the bidder's admission, checked in
the handler.

instructions.name: init_check_bids_comp_def
docs: Registers the `check_bids` circuit. Nodes fetch it from `circuit_url`
and refuse any file whose hash differs from the one compiled into this
program, so the URL's host cannot change what the circuit computes.

instructions.name: init_item_list
docs: Starts the item list of the collection auction that the seller will
open with `seed`, for a collection named per item: each item has a
name and a number of NFTs, its editions. `add_items` fills the list
and `create_collection_auction` seals it.

accounts.name: auction
docs: is used.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the platform config. Only the program's upgrade authority can
call this, so nobody can front-run the deployment and claim the admin.

instructions.name: join_auction
docs: Admits the calling wallet to a token sale with an allowlist, with a
proof that the list holds it: the sibling hashes from its leaf up to
the root (at most `MAX_ALLOWLIST_PROOF`). Makes the wallet's
`Participant`, which its bids then pass and which counts its deposits
against the sale's wallet cap. Its rent comes back with
`close_participant` once bidding is over.

instructions.name: open_book_page
docs: Opens the next page of a full bid book, so the auction grows on its own
up to `max_pages` pages (1,024 bids for a token auction, 10,240 for a
collection) and the seller pays nothing up front for room. Anyone may
call it, but only while bidding is open and only once every existing
page is full; `page` is the next page's number. The app adds it in
front of the bid that needs the room.
The caller pays the page's rent (and, with the second page, the paged
clearing's state and the book's index) and is paid it straight back
out of the auction's
settlement fund, which by then holds every bid's crank fee. The rent
goes to the seller when the auction closes. Rewards the fund then runs
short of, including the steps of the paged clearing, are paid out of
the proceeds (`crank_payment`).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays the rent and is paid it back from the settlement fund.

accounts.name: fold
docs: Made with the second page.

accounts.name: book
docs: The book's first page, read when its index starts.

accounts.name: book_index
docs: Made with the second page.

instructions.name: place_bid
docs: Stores an encrypted bid and escrows its deposit. No MPC runs here, so
bids never contend with each other.
The ciphertexts encrypt `BidInput { price, quantity }` for the MXE
under the bidder's x25519 key and `nonce`, which must equal `bid_nonce`
of this bid's address. That binding means a ciphertext copied from
another bid decrypts to noise here, so nobody can replay someone else's
bid into an auction whose terms they control and read it from the
result.
`client_pubkey_edwards_y` is the Edwards y-coordinate of the key, which
lets the program check the key exactly as Arcis does (see
`is_usable_x25519_key`). `terms` are the auction terms the bidder saw;
the bid is refused if the auction does not have exactly those.
Once every page of the auction's bid book is full (`bid_capacity`)
and no page can be added, pass the bid with the smallest deposit as
`evicted_bid` (and its owner as `evicted_bidder`); the new deposit must
exceed it by `EVICTION_PREMIUM_PERCENT`. The evicted bid is closed and
its owner gets the deposit and rent back.
`book` is the page the bid goes to: the page of index `bid_count`, or
of the evicted bid. A book with more than one page also passes its
`book_index`, which knows each page's smallest deposit.
A sale with an allowlist takes bids only from wallets that joined it
(`join_auction`): pass the bidder's `participant`, and when replacing
another wallet's bid, that wallet's as `evicted_participant`. With a
wallet cap, a wallet's deposits, across its bids, never exceed it.
For a token auction the encrypted quantity is the bid's budget in
lamports: a budget the deposit does not cover, or below
`min_deposit`, counts as no bid. For a collection auction a bid whose
price times quantity exceeds the deposit counts as no bid. Either way
such a bid is fully refunded later, and the deposit may exceed what it
covers to hide the bid.

accounts.name: book
docs: The page of the book the bid goes to; checked in the handler.

accounts.name: book_index
docs: Only for a book with more than one page: its index.

accounts.name: evicted_bid
docs: Only when the auction is full: the bid with the smallest deposit,
which this bid replaces.

accounts.name: evicted_bidder
docs: deposit and rent.

accounts.name: participant
docs: Only in a sale with an allowlist: the bidder's admission, checked in
the handler.

accounts.name: evicted_participant
docs: Only in a sale with an allowlist, when replacing another wallet's
bid: that wallet's admission, checked in the handler.

instructions.name: plan_liquidity
docs: Opts a token auction into auto-liquidity before any bid: `lp_bps` of
the net proceeds (20% to 100%), raised to at least `floor` lamports,
will open a Meteora DAMM v2 pool at the clearing price with a
`trade_fee_bps` fee (0.25%, 1% or 2%) after a 10-minute anti-sniper
fee. Escrows a reserve of as many tokens as are for sale and the
pool's rent; what the pool does not use comes back.

accounts.name: lp_authority
docs: will own the pool position.

accounts.name: reserve
docs: `init_if_needed` because anyone can create an associated token account.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: First step of a two-step admin handover.

instructions.name: refund_failed_bid
docs: Refunds a bid of a sale that missed its minimum raise or its pool's
minimum: no MPC needed, the whole deposit and the account's rent go
back to the bidder. Anyone can call it.

instructions.name: refund_unrevealed
docs: When a hidden collection was not revealed in time, gives a winning bid
its payment back. Once `REVEAL_DELAY_SECS` have passed since the end
of bidding and every bid is settled or refunded (the safety net
refunds any that cannot be), the payment moves from the auction back
to the bid, which then counts as having won nothing, so `close_bid`
returns its whole deposit. Anyone can call it; the lamports only go to
the bid.

instructions.name: release_liquidity
docs: Returns the reserve and the rent deposit to the seller when no pool
will open: the sale missed the floor, was cancelled, ended without
bids, or stalled until the safety net opened.

accounts.name: lp_wsol
docs: handler); closed if open.

instructions.name: reveal_collection
docs: Reveals a hidden collection: from now on its NFTs can be claimed, with
the metadata committed when the auction opened (`item_uri`), which
cannot change. Only the seller, once bidding has ended and before
`REVEAL_DELAY_SECS` have passed since. The files must be at
`item_uri` by then; the program cannot see them, but anyone can.

instructions.name: save_bid_note
docs: Stores the bidder's note on their bid, so they can see what they
sealed on any device, or rewrites it after `increase_bid`. The note is opaque here: the bidder's app
encrypts it under a key made from their wallet's signature, so only
they can read it. Its rent comes back with `close_bid_note`.

instructions.name: set_allowlist
docs: Records the allowlist of a token sale opened with one
(`SaleRules::allowlist`): the root of a Merkle tree of the wallets
allowed to bid (`allowlist_leaf`, `allowlist_node`) and where the list
itself is published (`uri`, at most `MAX_URI_LEN` bytes), so that
every wallet can find its proof and anyone can check the list matches
the root. Only the seller, once, before the first bid; until then no
wallet can join, so nobody can bid.

instructions.name: set_crank_rewards
docs: Sets the rewards paid to whoever runs each MPC step, for auctions
opened from now on (each auction keeps the rewards it opened with).
Each is capped at `MAX_CRANK_REWARD`. Admin only.

instructions.name: set_fees
docs: Sets the platform fees and the wallet that receives them. They apply
to auctions opened afterwards: an auction keeps the sale fee and
treasury it opened with. Both fees are capped (`MAX_LISTING_FEE`,
`MAX_SALE_FEE_BPS`), and sellers name the most they accept when they
open an auction, so a change can never surprise one.

instructions.name: set_listing
docs: Features or hides an auction in the listing. Affects display only.

instructions.name: settle_bid
docs: Decides one bid against the public clearing price, from the batch
record `check_batch` stored for it in the page of the book that holds
the bid (`book`). Anyone can call it. The callback
only records what the bid won and moves the payment to the auction; a
collection bid at the clearing price records its size and waits for
`finalize_share`. Tokens and the unused deposit are collected
afterwards with `claim_tokens` and `close_bid`, so settlement never
depends on the bidder's accounts.

accounts.name: book
docs: The page of the book that holds the bid's batch record, which the
cluster reads in place; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: tally_clearing_page
docs: Counts the collection bids at the clearing price on one page of a
book with more than one page, once every such bid is revealed:
`finalize_share` needs how many come before each bid and how many
NFTs rounding leaves over, and reads them from the `BookIndex`
instead of every page. Pages are counted in order, from 0; anyone can
call it, and nothing moves.

accounts.name: book
docs: The next page to count; checked in the handler.

errors.name: NotAtClearing
errors.msg: Only a collection bid at the clearing price has a share to finalize

errors.name: SharesNotReady
errors.msg: Not every bid at the clearing price has been revealed yet

errors.name: ShareReady
errors.msg: This bid's share is ready; finalize it instead

errors.name: InvalidMinDeposit
errors.msg: The minimum deposit must be above zero

errors.name: SeedAlreadyDrawn
errors.msg: The NFTs are already shuffled

errors.name: NftsNotShuffled
errors.msg: The NFTs are not shuffled yet; draw the seed first

errors.name: NothingSold
errors.msg: No NFTs were sold

errors.name: InvalidItems
errors.msg: Item names or numbers of NFTs are invalid

errors.name: TooManyItems
errors.msg: An item list holds at most 500 items

errors.name: ItemListSealed
errors.msg: This item list is sealed into an auction

errors.name: ItemListMismatch
errors.msg: The item list is missing or does not match this auction

errors.name: NotRevealed
errors.msg: The seller has not revealed this collection yet

errors.name: AlreadyRevealed
errors.msg: This collection is already revealed, or was never hidden

errors.name: RevealClosed
errors.msg: The time to reveal this collection is over

errors.name: InvalidStartTime
errors.msg: Bidding can start at most 30 days ahead

errors.name: BiddingNotStarted
errors.msg: Bidding has not started yet

errors.name: BidStillOpen
errors.msg: Only the bidder can close the note of a bid that is still open

errors.name: WrongBookPage
errors.msg: A page of the bid book is missing, out of order or not this auction's

errors.name: TooManyPages
errors.msg: An auction's bid book has at most four pages, added in order

errors.name: UsePagedClearing
errors.msg: The bids fill more than one page; find the clearing price with fold_clearing

errors.name: UseSingleClearing
errors.msg: The bids fit on one page; find the clearing price with find_clearing

errors.name: LiquidityAlreadyPlanned
errors.msg: This auction already has an auto-liquidity plan

errors.name: InvalidLiquidityShare
errors.msg: The pool's share of the proceeds must be between 20% and 100%

errors.name: InvalidLiquidityFloor
errors.msg: The pool's minimum SOL must be above zero

errors.name: InvalidPoolFee
errors.msg: The pool fee must be 0.25%, 1% or 2%

errors.name: LiquidityNotPlanned
errors.msg: This auction has no pending auto-liquidity plan

errors.name: LiquidityPending
errors.msg: The auto-liquidity plan must be carried out or released first

errors.name: LiquidityFloorMissed
errors.msg: The sale missed the pool's minimum; refund the bids with refund_failed_bid

errors.name: LiquidityStillNeeded
errors.msg: The reserve is still needed for the pool

errors.name: WrongPoolAccounts
errors.msg: The pool accounts do not match

errors.name: BookNotFull
errors.msg: A new page opens only once every page so far is full

errors.name: AlreadyTallied
errors.msg: Every page is already counted

errors.name: InvalidSaleRules
errors.msg: Sale rules are invalid: a wallet cap needs an allowlist and must allow at least the minimum deposit

errors.name: NoAllowlist
errors.msg: This sale has no allowlist

errors.name: InvalidAllowlist
errors.msg: The allowlist link is invalid

errors.name: NotOnAllowlist
errors.msg: This wallet is not on the sale's allowlist

errors.name: WalletCapExceeded
errors.msg: This would take the wallet's deposits past the sale's cap per wallet

errors.name: MinimumRaiseMissed
errors.msg: The sale missed its minimum raise; refund the bids with refund_failed_bid

errors.name: SaleNotFailed
errors.msg: The sale did not fail; settle the bids instead

types.name: Allowlist
docs: A token sale's allowlist (`[ALLOWLIST_SEED, auction]`): the Merkle root of
the wallets allowed to bid and where the list is published. Set once,
before any bid (`set_allowlist`).

fields.name: seed
docs: Seller-chosen value that, with the seller key, derives this address.

fields.name: mint
docs: The token, or the collection of a collection auction.

fields.name: token_program
docs: The token's program, or Metaplex Core.

fields.name: supply
docs: Base units of the token for sale, or NFTs.

fields.name: price_unit
docs: Base units one price refers to; 1 (one NFT) for a collection.

fields.name: price_scale
docs: Lamports per price tick: 1 for tokens, `NFT_PRICE_SCALE` for NFTs.

fields.name: min_price
docs: Lowest price that counts, in price ticks.

fields.name: min_deposit
docs: Smallest deposit a bid may make, in lamports.

fields.name: max_per_bid
docs: Collections: most NFTs one bid may ask for; 0 for tokens.

fields.name: checked_count
docs: Bids checked so far, in index order.

fields.name: resolved_count
docs: Bids that are settled or refunded.

fields.name: live_bids
docs: Bid accounts of this auction that are not closed yet.

fields.name: pending_computation
docs: Computation account of the auction-level computation in flight, or the
default key when none, with the slot and per-slot counter checked in
its callback.

fields.name: pending_batch
docs: Bids covered by the check in flight.

fields.name: clearing_price
docs: Price every winner pays, in price ticks: the minimum price when
demand never covered the supply.

fields.name: filled
docs: Whether demand covered the supply at the minimum price.

fields.name: weight_above
docs: Demand strictly above and exactly at the clearing price: lamports of
budget for tokens, NFTs for a collection.

fields.name: at_revealed
docs: Collections: NFTs asked for by bids revealed at the clearing price so
far. Once this reaches `weight_at`, their shares can be finalized.

fields.name: sold
docs: Base units or NFTs allocated to winners.

fields.name: delivered
docs: Base units delivered, or NFTs minted.

fields.name: proceeds
docs: Lamports paid by winners, held in this account until claimed.

fields.name: total_deposited
docs: Sum of the deposits of the auction's bids. A replaced bid takes its
deposit out of the total; refunds after bidding ends do not change it.

fields.name: sale_fee_bps
docs: Platform fee on the proceeds and where it goes, fixed when the auction
opened.

fields.name: royalty_bps
docs: Collection auctions: royalty on secondary sales, paid to the seller.

fields.name: uri_per_item
docs: Collection auctions: whether each NFT has its own metadata file
(see `nft_uri`) or all share `item_uri`.

fields.name: item_name
docs: Collection auctions: NFT names and metadata (see `nft_name`).

fields.name: assigned_positions
docs: Collection auctions: places handed out so far. Each winning bid takes
the next ones, one per NFT, when it settles (`Bid::first_position`).

fields.name: nft_seed
docs: Collection auctions: the seed `draw_nft_seed` drew once every bid was
settled, which turns places into NFT numbers (`shuffled_items`).

fields.name: named_items
docs: Collection auctions: whether NFTs take their names from the auction's
item list (`ItemList`) rather than `item_name`.

fields.name: unrevealed
docs: Hidden collections: whether the art is still to be revealed
(`reveal_collection`). Until then no NFT can be claimed.

fields.name: crank_rewards
docs: The rewards this auction pays for its MPC steps, fixed when it opened.

fields.name: crank_pool
docs: Lamports held in this account to pay them: the seller's and every
bid's crank fee, less the rewards paid. What is left goes to the
seller when the auction is closed.

fields.name: extra_pages
docs: Pages of the bid book beyond the first (`add_book_page`), each room
for `PAGE_BIDS` more bids, and the bumps of their addresses. Auctions
opened before pages existed read these as zero: one page.
Only the first `STORED_PAGE_BUMPS` bumps are kept (see
`page_address`).

fields.name: liquidity
docs: Token auctions: auto-liquidity state (`LIQUIDITY_*`, see
`liquidity`) and the least SOL its pool must get. Auctions opened
before auto-liquidity read zero: none.

fields.name: extended_secs
docs: Seconds the soft close has added to the end of bidding (see
`soft_close`); `end_time` already includes them. Older auctions read 0.

fields.name: prepaid_pages
docs: Pages the seller added and paid for ahead of time (`add_book_page`),
bit `p` for page `p`. Bids on the other extra pages pay a room fee
(`room_fee`). Older auctions read 0.

fields.name: min_raise
docs: Token sales: the least the winners must pay in all, in lamports, for
the sale to go ahead (0 for none). A sale that misses it sets
`raise_missed` when it clears, and every bid is refunded in full.

fields.name: wallet_cap
docs: Token sales with an allowlist: the most one wallet may deposit across
its bids, in lamports (0 for no cap).

fields.name: allowlist
docs: Token sales: whether only wallets on the sale's allowlist
(`Allowlist`) may bid.

fields.name: clearing_price
docs: Price every winner pays, in price ticks.

fields.name: swept_amount
docs: Tokens found in the vault and sent to the seller.

fields.name: mint
docs: The token, or the collection of a collection auction.

fields.name: listing_fee
docs: Listing fee paid.

fields.name: crank_pool
docs: What the seller put in the crank pool, and what each bid adds.

fields.name: sale_fee_bps
docs: Fee that will be taken from the proceeds.

types.name: AwardBidV2Output
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

fields.name: price_ciphertext
docs: These two must stay the first fields: the MPC cluster reads them in
place at `BID_CIPHERTEXT_OFFSET`.

fields.name: client_pubkey
docs: The bidder's x25519 public key used for this encryption.

fields.name: index
docs: Position in the auction's check order.

fields.name: deposit
docs: Lamports escrowed in this account on top of its rent. It covers a
token bid's private budget, or a collection bid's price times size.

fields.name: pending_computation
docs: Computation in flight for this bid, with the slot and per-slot counter
checked in its callback.

fields.name: won
docs: Base units or NFTs won.

fields.name: payment
docs: Lamports paid for them.

fields.name: delivered
docs: Whether everything this bid won has been delivered.

fields.name: nfts_claimed
docs: Collection auctions: NFTs minted to the bidder so far.

fields.name: first_position
docs: Collection auctions: the first of the places this bid took when it
settled, one per NFT won.

fields.name: quantity
docs: NFTs asked for, which the bid's share at the clearing price depends
on.

types.name: BidBook
docs: Per-auction storage too large to keep in `Auction`, which nearly every
instruction loads. Zero-copy, so only the parts used are touched.
One page of the book: room for `PAGE_BIDS` bids. Every auction has the
first page, `[BOOK_SEED, auction]`; `add_book_page` adds pages
`[BOOK_SEED, auction, [page]]`. Bid `index` lives on page
`index / PAGE_BIDS` at slot `index % PAGE_BIDS` (`page_slot`).

fields.name: batch_records
docs: The MXE-encrypted record of each checked batch: the `(price,
quantity)` of its bids (a token bid's quantity is its budget), packed
into two ciphertexts. Must stay the first field: the MPC cluster reads
records in place at `BATCH_RECORDS_OFFSET`.

fields.name: batch_nonces
docs: Little-endian nonce of each batch record.

fields.name: deposits
docs: Deposit of the bid at each slot: how the smallest deposit is found
when the auction is full.

fields.name: clearing_quantities
docs: NFTs asked for by the bid at each index if it was revealed at the
clearing price, else 0. `finalize_share` splits what is left there by
these.

fields.name: refund
docs: Unused deposit returned, not counting the account's rent.

fields.name: refund
docs: Deposit returned, not counting the account's rent.

fields.name: deposit
docs: The whole deposit now.

types.name: BidNote
docs: A bidder's note on their bid (see `save_bid_note`).

fields.name: note
docs: Encrypted by the bidder's app; opaque to the program.

fields.name: crank_fee
docs: Paid into the crank pool, not refunded.

fields.name: won
docs: Base units or NFTs won.

types.name: BiddingExtended
docs: A replacement near the end of bidding moved the end (soft close).

fields.name: extended_secs
docs: Seconds added to the original end so far.

types.name: BookIndex
docs: Per-page summaries of a book with more than one page
(`[INDEX_SEED, auction]`, made with its second page), so that no
instruction has to read every page.

fields.name: smallest_deposits
docs: The smallest deposit on each page, among its slots that hold a bid
(`u64::MAX` for none): once the book is full, the smallest of these is
the deposit a new bid must beat.

fields.name: tallied_pages
docs: Collections: pages whose bids at the clearing price are counted
(`tally_clearing_page`), in order from the first.

fields.name: at_before
docs: Bids at the clearing price on the pages before each counted page.

fields.name: at_count
docs: The counted bids at the clearing price, their sizes and the sum of
their rounded-down shares (see `clearing_share`).

fields.name: max_bids
docs: Bids the auction can now hold.

fields.name: crank_fee
docs: Added to the crank pool for the paged clearing.

types.name: BookPageOpened
docs: A page opened on demand (`open_book_page`).

fields.name: max_bids
docs: Bids the auction can now hold.

fields.name: rent_advanced
docs: Rent paid back to the caller out of the settlement fund.

types.name: CheckBidsV2Output
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: ClearPriceV2Output
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: ClearingFold
docs: The paged clearing of an auction with more than one page of bid book
(`[FOLD_SEED, auction]`, made with its second page): what `fold_batch`
carries from step to step, and where it is.

fields.name: state
docs: The MXE-encrypted state of the last step. Must stay the first field:
the MPC cluster reads it in place at `FOLD_STATE_OFFSET`.

fields.name: pass
docs: Pass and page of the next step; `pass` is `FOLD_PASSES` once done.

fields.name: steps
docs: Steps done so far.

fields.name: prefix
docs: The digits of the clearing price fixed so far.

types.name: ClearingFolded
docs: A step of the paged clearing succeeded.

fields.name: prefix
docs: The digits of the clearing price fixed so far.

fields.name: bids_at_price
docs: Bids at the clearing price on that page.

types.name: ClockAccount
docs: An account storing the current network epoch

fields.name: item_uri
docs: Where the revealed metadata is, as committed when the auction opened.

types.name: CollectionSaleTerms
docs: What a collection auction sells, its minimum price and when bidding runs.

fields.name: supply
docs: NFTs for sale.

fields.name: min_price
docs: Lowest price per NFT that counts, in ticks of `NFT_PRICE_SCALE`
lamports.

fields.name: max_per_bid
docs: Most NFTs one bid may ask for.

fields.name: start_time
docs: When bidding opens (unix seconds); 0 or a past time for right away.

types.name: CollectionTerms
docs: What a collection auction sells (see `create_collection_auction`).

fields.name: name
docs: Collection name and metadata URI.

fields.name: item_name
docs: NFT name, before " #1", " #2" and so on.

fields.name: item_uri
docs: NFT metadata: a base URI if `uri_per_item`, else the URI of every NFT.

fields.name: royalty_bps
docs: Royalty on secondary sales, paid to the seller; 0 for none.

fields.name: hidden
docs: Whether the art stays hidden until the seller reveals it after the
sale (see `reveal_collection`).

types.name: ComputationDefinitionAccount
docs: An account representing a [ComputationDefinition] in a MXE.

types.name: ComputationDefinitionMeta
docs: A computation definition for execution in a MXE.

types.name: ComputationSignature
docs: The signature of a computation defined in a [ComputationDefinition].

types.name: CrankConfig
docs: Crank rewards for auctions opened from now on (`[CRANK_SEED]`).

fields.name: from_proceeds
docs: The part the settlement fund could not cover, taken from the proceeds.

types.name: CrankRewards
docs: Lamports paid to whoever runs each MPC step, when its computation
succeeds: a batch check, the clearing, one bid's settlement, and a
collection's seed draw. They cover the fees the caller paid to queue it.

types.name: DrawSeedOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: Epoch
docs: The network epoch

types.name: ExpectedTerms
docs: The auction terms a bidder saw when signing. `place_bid` refuses the bid
unless the auction has exactly these terms, so neither a stale view nor a
lying RPC node can make a bid land on terms the bidder did not see.

fields.name: min_raise
docs: The sale's minimum raise (0 for none): a bidder relies on it being
met for the sale to go ahead.

types.name: FeeConfig
docs: Platform fees for auctions opened from now on (`[FEES_SEED]`).

fields.name: listing_fee
docs: Lamports charged to open an auction.

fields.name: sale_fee_bps
docs: Share of each sale's proceeds, in basis points.

fields.name: treasury
docs: System account receiving both fees.

types.name: FeeTerms
docs: The most a seller accepts to pay in platform fees. Opening an auction
fails if the current fees are higher.

types.name: FoldBatchV2Output
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: ItemList
docs: The items of a collection auction named per item. Item `k` covers NFT
numbers from the previous item's end (0 for the first) up to its own end.
`count` entries of `ITEM_ENTRY_LEN` bytes follow this header, from
`ITEM_LIST_HEADER_LEN`.

fields.name: auction
docs: The auction this list is for (its address, before it exists).

fields.name: count
docs: Entries written so far.

fields.name: total
docs: NFTs the entries add up to: the last entry's end.

fields.name: sealed
docs: Set when the auction opens with this list; it cannot change after.

types.name: LeaderChoice
docs: The computation chosen by a node to be executed when the node is leader.

types.name: LeaderInfo
docs: The information about a node.

types.name: LeaderSelector
docs: To select a Leader.
Uses the greatest divisors method: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D%27Hondt_method

types.name: LiquidityPlan
docs: A seller's auto-liquidity terms and, once opened, the pool. Kept after the
auction closes: it says where the pool's fees go.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives the platform's share of the pool's fees.

fields.name: reserve
docs: Tokens escrowed for the pool.

fields.name: pool_sol
docs: What went into the pool.

fields.name: fees_to_seller
docs: Pool fees paid out so far, in lamports.

fields.name: pool_taken
docs: Whether DAMM v2's pool for the pair already existed.

types.name: MXEAccount
docs: A MPC Execution Environment.

fields.name: raised
docs: What the winners would have paid in all.

types.name: MxeStatus
docs: The status of an MXE.

types.name: NewItem
docs: An item for an item list: its name and how many NFTs it has.

fields.name: first_position
docs: The first of the bid's places minted now; the others follow it.

fields.name: items
docs: The NFT numbers (from 0) minted, one per place; NFT `i` is named
`"{item_name} #{i + 1}"`.

fields.name: seed
docs: Turns places into NFT numbers (see `shuffled_items`).

types.name: NodeMetadata
docs: location as [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html) country code

types.name: NodeRef
docs: A reference to a node in the cluster.
The offset is to derive the Node Account.

types.name: Output
docs: An output of a computation.
We currently don't support encrypted outputs yet since encrypted values are passed via
data objects.

types.name: Parameter
docs: A parameter of a computation.
We differentiate between plaintext and encrypted parameters and data objects.
Plaintext parameters are directly provided as their value.
Encrypted parameters are provided as an offchain reference to the data.
Data objects are provided as a reference to the data object account.

types.name: Participant
docs: A wallet admitted to a token sale with an allowlist
(`[PARTICIPANT_SEED, auction, wallet]`, `join_auction`), and what it has
deposited across its bids, which the sale's wallet cap applies to.

fields.name: proceeds
docs: Proceeds before the fee; the seller received `proceeds - fee`.

fields.name: unsold_amount
docs: Unsold tokens returned, or unsold NFTs (never minted).

types.name: SaleRules
docs: A token sale's optional rules, fixed when it opens.

fields.name: min_raise
docs: The least the winners must pay in all, in lamports; 0 for none.

fields.name: wallet_cap
docs: The most one wallet may deposit across its bids, in lamports; 0 for
no cap. Only with an allowlist, since without one a wallet cap is
undone by splitting bids across wallets.

fields.name: allowlist
docs: Whether only wallets on an allowlist may bid (`set_allowlist`,
`join_auction`).

types.name: SetUnset
docs: Utility struct to store a value that needs to be set by a certain number of participants (keys
in our case). Once all participants have set the value, the value is considered set and we only
store it once.

types.name: TokenSaleTerms
docs: What a token auction sells, its minimum price and when bidding runs.

fields.name: supply
docs: Base units for sale, escrowed when the auction opens.

fields.name: price_unit
docs: Base units one price refers to: a power of ten up to
`MAX_PRICE_UNIT`.

fields.name: min_price
docs: Lowest price that counts, in lamports per `price_unit`.

fields.name: min_deposit
docs: Smallest deposit, and smallest private budget, a bid may make, in
lamports.

fields.name: start_time
docs: When bidding opens (unix seconds); 0 or a past time for right away.
